svg.title: \begin{array}{l}\widetilde {t_S} = \frac {{E_{S2}}}{{E_{S1}}} = \frac {{2n_1\cos i_1}}{{n_1\cos i_1 + n_2\cos i_2}} = \frac {{2\sin i_2\cos i_1}}{{\sin (i_1 + i_2)}}\\\widetilde {t_P} = \frac {{E_{P2}}}{{E_{P1}}} = \frac {{2n_1\cos i_1}}{{n_2\cos i_1 + n_1\cos i_2}} = \frac {{2\sin i_2\cos i_1}}{{\sin (i_1 + i_2)\cos (i_1 - i_2)}}\end{array}
